summary: Tested «Modo laboratorio» (Pepperstone) on the backend and the frontend. Backend: 9/9 tests pass (iter57 plus the new iter58, which compares every settings/config key on restore). Frontend: lab card, confirm dialog (cancel and confirm), toasts, active badge, stats grid, Plan de trading showing Cruce EMA 10/20 · 15M · criterios relajados, chart switching to 15m, altered warning after enabling Filtro TF superior, stop/restore back to Multi-estrategia (5) · 1h, Evolución lab events and no lab card on /hotforex all work, with no console errors. The real-LLM Chat IA answer describes the lab correctly. Bot start/stop works and the bot was left STOPPED. One HIGH logic bug: applying a risk profile while the lab is on leaves 8 lab-disabled settings OFF.

critical.issue: Profiles (fx/profiles.py) do not define trailing_enabled, partial_tp_enabled, vol_filter_enabled, seasonality_bias, usd_regime_filter, fomc_rule, rollover_guard or sessions_allowed. end_by_profile only restores 'strategy' and the config, so after start lab → profile level 2 all 8 settings stay at lab values (False / []). profile_active still reports 2, so the user silently loses trailing, partial TP and every market gate. Reproduced from a clean state.

minor.issue: The lab event offers 'Deshacer'. Undoing it reverts the settings but leaves the lab doc active and the news/auto-review config OFF, so the state becomes inconsistent. Consider hiding undo for source 'lab' or routing it through lab.stop.
Start is blocked in live (409), but nothing ends the lab if the account later goes live while it is active.

issues: rollover_guard, vol_filter_enabled, seasonality_bias, usd_regime_filter, fomc_rule and partial_tp_enabled show as raw keys; add Spanish labels to LABELS
The Cruce EMA 10/20 description says 'dejando correr la tendencia con el trailing del bot', but trailing is OFF in the lab

action_items: HIGH: in lab.end_by_profile, also restore the pre-lab values of the keys the profile does not define. Simplest: return {k: prev_settings[k] for k in SETTINGS_PATCH if k not in PROFILES[level]['settings']}, so strategy, trailing_enabled, partial_tp_enabled, vol_filter_enabled, seasonality_bias, usd_regime_filter, fomc_rule, rollover_guard and sessions_allowed come back. Update the confirm-dialog text ('solo se restauran noticias y revisión IA automática') to match.
Add a test: start lab → profile 2 → assert the 8 keys equal their pre-lab values.
Minor: hide or redirect 'Deshacer' for lab events in Evolución; add Spanish labels for the gate keys; fix the trailing wording in the lab Plan text.
critical_code_review_comments: fx/lab.py end_by_profile docstring assumes profiles only lack strategy and the news config, but they also lack trailing, partial TP, the 5 market gates and sessions.
The original test_iter57 profile test restored only a subset of keys, so every run left vol/usd/fomc/seasonality/rollover OFF on the live preview DB. Its teardown is now fixed to restore all keys.

success_rate.backend: 100% of tests (9/9); 1 logic bug found by manual diff

seed_data_creation: None. Lab/profile events were added to Pepperstone Evolución.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final Pepperstone state matches the pre-test snapshot exactly: profile Activo (2), strategy all, 1h, all filters on, lab OFF, bot STOPPED. Run lab tests with -n 0. After any profile test, diff the full /api/pepper/settings against a snapshot.
rca of the issue: Repro: from the default state, POST /api/pepper/lab/start, then POST /api/pepper/profile {level:2}. The response shows trailing_enabled, partial_tp_enabled, vol_filter_enabled, seasonality_bias, usd_regime_filter, fomc_rule and rollover_guard false and sessions_allowed [], with profile_active 2. Cause: profile_patch only sets the keys in PROFILES[level]['settings'], and end_by_profile only adds strategy, so the other lab-patched keys keep their lab values. Fix: merge the pre-lab values of the non-profile keys into the profile patch.
